note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Congress's own texts. The Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Zacatecas (last reform POG 22 Aug 2026), art. 118, I, charges an automovilista licence, the medical exam included, $230.00 for one year, $452.00 for two, $821.00 for four and $986.00 for six (figures reformed POG 28 Dec 2024); until the form took terms (2026-10-30) the file held the one-year term and its fee; from then it holds the four terms, each at its fee. The Ley de Transporte, Tránsito y Vialidad del Estado de Zacatecas (last reform POG 30 Sep 2026) has the licence issued by the Secretaría de Seguridad (the state's Secretaría de Seguridad Pública) (art. 38) and only to adults (mayores de edad), as chofer, automovilista or motociclista (art. 39); the Código Familiar del Estado de Zacatecas (art. 608) puts majority at eighteen, which is the age held.
